fluff.overview: A medium-sized mob numbers enough armed civilians to pose a genuine security problem for garrison forces. Equipped with improvised firearms and incendiary grenades, these crowds can overwhelm a checkpoint, storm a supply depot, or blockade a major road. They still lack military discipline and will break under concentrated fire, but their numbers make them harder to disperse without escalation. Medium mobs often form around organized agitators or local leaders who can channel collective anger into directed action, even if that direction is crude. Garrison troops dealing with a medium mob face an unpleasant choice between measured response and the risk of a situation spiraling beyond control.
